changelog:
- Added new Plugin Management functionality with dedicated module and APIs for listing, installing, uninstalling, and uploading Elasticsearch plugins.
- Expanded instance lifecycle operations to support actions like password reset, instance renaming, charge type conversion, version upgrades, and change record queries.
- Introduced support for managing Kibana settings and updating cluster YML configuration.
- Updated intent routing and documentation to reflect new modules and API coverage.
- Removed outdated file (skill-card.md) for clarity.
